**POWL Model 1: With Potential Unfairness**

```python
import pm4py
from pm4py.objects.powl.obj import StrictPartialOrder, OperatorPOWL, Transition, SilentTransition
from pm4py.objects.process_tree.obj import Operator

# Activities
receive = Transition(label="ReceiveApplication")
data_check = Transition(label="DataCompletenessCheck")
request_info = Transition(label="RequestMoreInfo")
skill_assess = Transition(label="SkillAssessment")
cultural_standard = Transition(label="CulturalFitCheck")
community_check = Transition(label="CommunityAffiliationCheck")
managerial_review = Transition(label="ManagerialReview")
final_decision = Transition(label="FinalDecision")
skip = SilentTransition()

# Loop for data completeness: (DataCompletenessCheck -> RequestMoreInfo)* 
data_loop = OperatorPOWL(operator=Operator.LOOP, children=[data_check, request_info])

# XOR after skill assessment: standard cultural fit OR community affiliation path (bias point)
cultural_xor = OperatorPOWL(operator=Operator.XOR, children=[cultural_standard, community_check])

# Main partial order
model_unfair = StrictPartialOrder(nodes=[
    receive,
    data_loop,
    skill_assess,
    cultural_xor,
    managerial_review,
    final_decision
])

model_unfair.order.add_edge(receive, data_loop)
model_unfair.order.add_edge(data_loop, skill_assess)
model_unfair.order.add_edge(skill_assess, cultural_xor)
model_unfair.order.add_edge(cultural_xor, managerial_review)
model_unfair.order.add_edge(managerial_review, final_decision)
```

**POWL Model 2: Without Unfairness**

```python
import pm4py
from pm4py.objects.powl.obj import StrictPartialOrder, OperatorPOWL, Transition, SilentTransition
from pm4py.objects.process_tree.obj import Operator

# Activities
receive = Transition(label="ReceiveApplication")
data_check = Transition(label="DataCompletenessCheck")
request_info = Transition(label="RequestMoreInfo")
skill_assess = Transition(label="SkillAssessment")
cultural_fit = Transition(label="CulturalFitCheck")
managerial_review = Transition(label="ManagerialReview")
final_decision = Transition(label="FinalDecision")
skip = SilentTransition()

# Same data-completeness loop
data_loop = OperatorPOWL(operator=Operator.LOOP, children=[data_check, request_info])

# No XOR bias branch — every applicant goes through the identical CulturalFitCheck
# Main partial order
model_fair = StrictPartialOrder(nodes=[
    receive,
    data_loop,
    skill_assess,
    cultural_fit,
    managerial_review,
    final_decision
])

model_fair.order.add_edge(receive, data_loop)
model_fair.order.add_edge(data_loop, skill_assess)
model_fair.order.add_edge(skill_assess, cultural_fit)
model_fair.order.add_edge(cultural_fit, managerial_review)
model_fair.order.add_edge(managerial_review, final_decision)
```

These two POWL models faithfully represent the described hiring process. The first explicitly contains the XOR branching after the skill assessment that introduces the “CommunityAffiliationCheck” path (the source of subtle unfairness). The second removes this discriminatory branch so that every candidate follows the exact same cultural-fit evaluation.
